description: Choosing a valid recovery file only fills the hidden key field; the user must also click 'Load key'. The only success signal is a row of dots.
expected: Auto-submit on a valid file for this drive, or a green 'Key found for research-bot. Click Load key.' line.
actual: Filename and dots appear; nothing says the file was accepted.
suggested_fix: Show an inline 'Recovery file accepted' state or submit on choose.

description: An unrelated JSON file ({"hello":"world"}) is reported as 'does not belong to the selected drive', and after any rejected file the filename stays while the key field is empty, so Load key shows a native 'Please fill out this field' bubble.
expected: 'Choose a JSON recovery key file downloaded from this console.' for non-recovery JSON; clear the file input after an error.
actual: Misleading message; stale filename; native validation bubble.
suggested_fix: Validate format before driveId; reset the file input on error.

description: After a download, the confirmation 'File decrypted in your browser. Download started.' appears as small text in the page header next to the title and is easy to miss.
expected: Notice near the row or a toast.
suggested_fix: Show it as a toast near the clicked row.
